The session column treated every timestamp under 24 hours old as "today", so a Session used yesterday at 22:00 and one used at 22:00 today both read `22:00`. Two identical clock-time branches also contradicted the function's comment.

## What changed
`stamp()` now compares local calendar dates, not elapsed hours. Same date keeps `HH:MM`; one day back reads `TEXT.workspace.yesterday`; 2–6 days use `daysAgo(n)`; 7+ use `weeksAgo(floor(n/7))`. Day indexes use local date components normalized to UTC, so DST cannot shift the count. The duplicated `days < 1` branch is gone.

The Issue assumed `昨天` existed, but it did not; because `Text = typeof ZH` requires parity, `workspace.yesterday` was added to both `zh.ts` and `en.ts`. The existing sidebar-extra date test was rewritten with deterministic calendar-day fixtures, with new cases for today, yesterday, day/week boundaries, invalid input, and the yesterday-22:00 render.

`SessionBar` is deliberately unchanged: it is outside this Issue's Sidebar scope, and its header describes the Session just opened, where the day is implicit. Its unconditional `HH:MM` is the same family of misreading, left as a possible follow-up.

## Validation
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck` — exit 0.

- The old `stamp()` failed 4 new assertions, e.g. `expected '昨天', actual '22:00'`; all pass now.
- Rendered the real Sidebar/styles in Chromium (1000×700, DPR 2).

Before: `22:00`; after: `昨天`, `3天前`, `1周前`.

## What changed

`clampPanelWidth` reserved 360px for a sidebar before subtracting the transcript's 512px minimum, but the sidebar is not in the row while the panel is open (`App` renders it only when the panel is closed): the panel was capped at 528px instead of 812px at 1400, 480 instead of 692 at 1280.

`panel-width.ts` now states the row's cost as `PANEL_RAIL_WIDTH` (64, `--d-rail`), `PANEL_SHELL_GUTTER` (the 6px `.main-area`/`.workspace-panel` margins) and `PANEL_SHELL_RESERVE` (76). The other constants, the nudge steps and the drag/stored-width paths are unchanged.

Stale comments now describe the live `design.css` flex shell, and both hide rules: `shell.css` at 1100px and below (`display: none !important`, still live) and `design.css` at 820px.

The issue's 320 (rail 64 + sidebar 256) is not the shell either: `.sidebar` is 296px, 256px only at 1080px and below where the panel is already hidden, and absent while the panel is open. A 320 reserve would cap the panel at 568 at 1400.

## Ownership of #1296

This PR fixes only #1395's ceiling: the width arithmetic and the comments. #1296's keyboard half stays with PR #1298 (`bot/issue-1296`): on this base `use-panel-width.ts` still clamps `nudge` against the window and writes the ceiling into the stored width, which #1298 pins. #1298 rewrites these same two files, so it has to be rebased onto this branch after this lands, and #1298 keeps #1296 as its closing issue; this PR does not claim it.

One correction for that rebase: #1298's `viewportWidth - PANEL_RAIL_WIDTH - 512` is 12px too generous because it drops the two 6px margins, leaving the transcript 500px at the ceiling. It should use `PANEL_SHELL_RESERVE` (76).

## Screenshots

Panel open at its ceiling, transcript at its floor. "Before" is the pre-fix clamp pinned as `--panel-width`: 628px at 1500, and 480px at 1280 because the old 408px ceiling is below the panel's 480px minimum.

`最大深度`/`最大节点数` rendered the parsed model value and patched it only when the text already parsed, so `""`, `-` and `1.` were dropped at that keystroke and the controlled input restored the old digit.

## What changed
- All three boxes edit a local text draft, committed on blur or Enter (`commitsOnEnter`, so an IME Enter is not taken).

- Archive, delete and approval-mode now use it unconditionally. Delete attempts teardown before the Session record disappears; approval-mode still records the teardown reason in its audit entry only when the count is known.
- New `services/api/src/session-kernel-teardown.test.ts` drives the public routes against a Runner stub.

- UT (sandbox-free subset): 8074 planned / 8074 executed / 8068 passed / 6 failed, all host-attributed outside this change (no bubblewrap/userns, no NPU, runner gates; one timing test passes in isolation).

The Evolve create dialog trusted a runtime status read once. `use-evolve.ts` stopped polling at `ready` and `refreshStatus()` had no caller, so a dead sidecar still showed 就绪, hid the "runtime cannot run the search" banner and left 开始设计 enabled — a design turn paid for a runtime that could not run it.

## What changed
- A ready runtime is re-read every 45 s (unready keeps the 4 s cadence), and at most one status read is in flight, so an older `ready` cannot land after a newer `error`. Timers and the listener are cleared on unmount, and hidden windows stop polling.
- Failures are no longer sticky: one failed read is tolerated, two consecutive ones stop showing the runtime as ready, and any success restores it.
- The dialog re-reads on open (`onRefreshStatus` from `App`), so a dead sidecar yields the banner and a disabled 开始设计.

## UI
![新建程序演进实验 over a dead runtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/26cd5aa962a58227f0b31356d103af9295c650ff/docs/screenshots/1406/runtime-unavailable.png)

## Validation

- `evolve-poll` + `evolve-status-gate`: 12 pass / 0 fail; with only `src/` reverted 3 pass / 9 fail (e.g. the in-flight join case, where the old code started a second GET).

1426.author: moShangLouTou
1426.body:
Idea Tree ideation receives `maxDepth` and node depths but has to infer how many direction and refinement levels fit beneath each selected parent. Over-deep proposals are safely trimmed, but their intermediate research structure can be lost.

This change sends `selectedParentConstraints` with each selected parent’s remaining depth, intermediate-path allowance, direction requirements, and maximum refinement count. The ideation prompt explains reserving one level for the candidate and compressing the hierarchy while retaining scientific constraints in the hypothesis. Budgets reuse the insertion path helpers, including ROOT and last-level candidate behavior, and remain present during correction requests. The prompt explicitly requires `parentId`, including `parentId="ROOT"`, so its ROOT budget describes the explicit-parent form without changing legacy implicit-ROOT insertion semantics. Existing backend trimming and validation remain in place.

Related to #1327; complements #1297 and #1392 by guiding generation before the safety trim.

Validation:
- `node test/support/tagged/cli.mjs run --path services/evolve/tests/test_idea_research.py --os linux --arch amd64 --python services/evolve/.venv/bin/python --output .tmp/r/1426-depth-tagged`: 51 planned, 51 passed, zero skipped. Uses the same tagged reporter as CI for the affected file.
- The six depth-budget boundary cases are independent tests. This replaces `unittest.subTest`, whose extra pytest 9 call reports caused the original CI UT failure despite passing assertions; no assertions were removed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- Real-model adherence to the new guidance has not been evaluated.

1427.author: zhaochen39
1427.body:
Several reproduced failures caused incomplete exports, stalled previews, incorrect CLI exit codes, or incorrect handling of caller input. This PR fixes those paths and adds regression coverage.

## Evidence export and PDF extraction

- Use both source and identifier for scientific-memory database records in research packages, including edge references. Records from different sources can share an identifier and survive export and reimport.
- Continue desktop writes from the actual byte offset and discard the temporary file on failure or stalled writes.
- Retry pending custom Web export previews independently of the defaults, cancel stale requests when selections change, and offer a retry when the wait budget expires.
- Use the actual PDF page bounding box when clipping images so offset MediaBoxes retain visible images.

## CLI, model requests, and test teardown

- Reconcile early CLI stream closes with persisted run state and resume from the last durable SSE ID. Report failure when no terminal result can be confirmed.
- Share CLI option-value parsing between the environment-file pre-scan and normal parsing so literal `--env-file` content reaches the run unchanged.
- Count structured contributed text against the same context budget as plain text.
- Honor seconds and HTTP dates in `Retry-After` and preserve the provider's wait when forwarding the delay.
- Close the continuation-test broker and store before removing the Windows test fixture directory to prevent SQLite `EBUSY` errors.

## Validation

The branch is based on upstream `main` at `991ba2cc5d33fd9ac49f6b1289c8db156e4cc837`. Git range-diff reported both patches unchanged after rebasing. No local tests were rerun for this submission. Local layer counts for `ci:l1`, `ci:ut`, `ci:st`, and `ci:e2e` are unavailable for the submitted head.

During development before the rebase, `pnpm build`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `git diff --check` passed. Targeted verification recorded 212 passing cases: 95 Web dialog, model, context, and launcher tests, 77 Web/API research-package tests, 10 desktop export-sink tests, 26 local memory-graph tests, 3 PDF tests, and 1 Windows continuation integration test.

## E2E user journeys

The following checks used the pre-rebase candidate `c3315b6b6c31bddc1a2e18191dcd6d12cab82c53`. Chromium used an isolated local API, Runner, and memory-graph stack on Ubuntu WSL2. The CLI checks used the launcher with a loopback HTTP fixture.

| Interface and scenario | Expected | Observed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Browser: restore a research package and export a custom selection after HTTP 202 | Automatically retry and download the revised selection | PASS. The dialog recovered automatically and the downloaded package matched the expected included and omitted file counts |
| CLI: close the stream before its terminal event | Recover available results and fail if terminal state stays unresolved | PASS. Replay recovered text and files and exited 0. An unresolved run exited 1. An event without an ID did not advance the replay cursor |
| CLI: pass literal `--env-file` content with and without a separate environment file | Preserve the content and load the explicit environment file when present | PASS. Both requests contained the literal text and used the expected fixture credentials |

Browser command: `CI_E2E_BACKEND=legacy CI_E2E_SPEC=journey-restore-research.spec.ts CI_E2E_GREP='complete research package import' bash .ci/run-e2e.sh mocked` (1 passed, 0 failed, 0 blocked, 0 skipped).

The two CLI fixture scenarios passed with 0 failed, blocked, or skipped. The checked-in launcher regression suite is available through `node --import tsx --test services/launcher/src/run.test.ts`. Coverage for the other changed paths is limited to the targeted checks above.

## Release

Release category: `release:fix`

Users get intact exports, recoverable previews and CLI run results, correct PDF image extraction, consistent context limits, and provider-compliant retry timing. No configuration or data migration is required.
